situation: The document analysis subagent extracts an evidence_type field using a JSON Schema enum of experiment, survey, expert_interview, and market_report. In testing, vague passages are often forced into a specific category, while new source types sometimes produce values outside the schema and fail downstream validation.
question: What change best improves the schema design while preserving reliable categorization?

options.A: Add "unclear" and "other" enum values plus an other_detail field, and instruct when to use each.
options.B: Remove the enum constraint from evidence_type and ask each subagent to write the best category label.
options.C: Keep the current enum list and instruct the model to select the closest category for every passage.
options.D: Make evidence_type required and retry whenever validation fails until a listed category is returned.

why: A robust structured extraction schema should constrain predictable values while still representing edge cases honestly. JSON Schema enum is useful for categorical fields because it limits outputs to known values, but a taxonomy that lacks valid categories for ambiguous or novel inputs can push the model toward false precision. Adding application-defined values such as "unclear" and "other" is a schema design pattern, not a special Anthropic requirement. "unclear" gives the model a valid way to report insufficient evidence, while "other" plus an other_detail field lets downstream systems preserve information about emerging categories without accepting arbitrary strings in the primary field. Anthropic documents structured output mechanisms through structured outputs, including JSON Schema-based outputs and strict tool use, and also shows JSON Schema enum usage in tool input schemas. (Docs: structured outputs, implement tool use.)
title: Enum with unclear and other

task.config_change: Change the document-analysis prompt so each finding carries `evidence_type` from [experiment, survey, expert_interview, market_report, unclear, other] plus `other_detail` when `other` is used, with instructions on when to pick unclear.
task.prompt_template: Research this topic and deliver a cited report: {{topic}}. Classify every document finding's evidence type.

expected_outcome: All evidence_type values are inside the enum; vague passages use `unclear`; any `other` carries other_detail.
rubric: every evidence_type is a member of the six-value enum
no finding is forced into a specific category when the text is vague (at least one unclear or other, or a justification)
every other has a non-empty other_detail
